Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have alignment on milestones, stakeholders, and the decision process. Please confirm or edit where I missed something.

Pain points (as discussed):
- Inference latency variability on 1k+ concurrent users impacting UX.
- Rising per-token cost with current caching strategy.
- Need for private deployment option for PII-sensitive workflows.

Goals:
- Pilot Redwood inference on a subset of product traffic to validate 50% cost reduction per 1k tokens and 99th percentile latency < 300ms.
- Verify security posture (SOC 2 evidence, VPC options).

Stakeholders / decision roles (as I heard):
- Sarah Blake — Dir. of ML (owner, evaluation lead)
- Tom Rivera — VP Engineering (approver for infra spend)
- Procurement / Legal (contracts & SOW)

Proposed milestones (dates tentative):
1) Week of 6/14 — Provide MAP & SOC2 summary (you) / Redwood to share detailed pilot plan and infra checklist
2) Week of 6/21 — Technical review + SE deep-dive (Dev Patel to join)
3) Week of 6/28 — Pilot kickoff (sample traffic, telemetry)
4) By 7/05 — Exec sign-off / procurement approval

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (draft MAP with milestones and owners)

Asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm stakeholders and procurement timeline?
- Are there any must-have compliance checkpoints beyond SOC 2 we should include?
- Available times for the SE deep-dive next week (Dev, copying him here).

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,
